what_it_does: This work introduces an open-source framework that accelerates the movement of data from Ethernet network interfaces directly to NVMe storage devices without involving the host CPU. A field-programmable gate array (FPGA) sits between the network and storage, handling all data routing and classification logic. The framework is demonstrated on image streams, where a deep neural network classifier runs on the FPGA to filter and organize incoming images in real time before they land on disk.
